book.name: 1 Teselonqe Kiita
book.title: Phawuloosi Teselonqe Asaas Xaafida Koyro Kiita

content: Phawuloosi Teselonqen Oothida ooso
Ta ishato, nuuni hinteko biday mela gidonnaysa hinte, hinte huuphen ereeta.
Shin nuuni hinteko Teselonqe yaanape sinthe Filphisiyuusa kataman waayetidaysanne cayetidaysa hinte ereeta. Daro ixoy de7ikoka hintew iya Wongela odana mela Xoossay nuus minotethi immis.
Nuuni hintena zoriday balethon woyko cimon woyko genen gidenna.
Shin Xoossay nunan ammanetidi ba Wongela odana mela nuus hadara immida gisho odoos. Nu hessa oothey nu wozanaa be7iya Xoossaa ufaysanaasafe attishin, ase ufaysanaasa gidenna.
Nu miishe yaaridi wordo hintena sabbishe hinteko yoonnaysa loythidi ereeta; Xoossay nuus marka.
Nuuni hintefe gidin woyko hara asa oodefeka boncho koyibooko.
Nuuni Kiristoosa hawaare gideysada nuus koshshiyaba immite gidi ekanaw danda7oos, shin aayiya ba nayta dicheysa mela hinte giddon ashke gidida.
Nu hintena dosida gisho Xoossaa Wongela hintew shaako xalaala gidonashin, nu de7uwaka hintew immanaw giigida. Hinte nuus daro al7o.
Nu ishato, nu oosuwanne nu daabura ereeta. Hintew Xoossaa Wongela odishe, hintena waaysonna mela qammanne gallas oothida.
Nu de7oy hinte ammaneyisata mataninne Xoossaa sinthan geeshshi, xillonne boretonaysa gideysas hinte marka.
Nuuni hintew huuphen huuphen yelidaysati banta naytas haneysada hanidaysa ereeta.
Nu hintena zorida, minthethida. Qassi ba kawotethaanne ba bonchuwa shaakanaw hintena xeegiya Xoossaa ufaysiya de7o hinte daana mela hintew minthidi odida.
Hintew nuuni Xoossaa qaala odida wode asa qaalada gidonashin, Xoossaa qaalada si7idi ekida gisho nuuni ubba wode Xoossaa galatoos. I tuma Xoossaa qaala; Xoossaa qaalay ammaniya hintenan oothees.
Ta ishato, hinte Yihuda biittan de7iya woosa keethatanne yan Kiristoos Yesuusa kaalliya asatada hanideta. Enta Ayhudeti waaysidaysada hintenaka hinte biitta asay waaysidosona.
He Ayhudeti Godaa Yesuusanne nabeta wodhidosona; qassi nuna goodidosona. Enti Xoossaa ufaysonaysatanne ase ubbaa ixeyisata.

Enti hari attoshin, Ayhude gidonna asay attana mela nuuni entaw qaala odeysa diggoosona. Hessada hanidi enta nagaraa xuu7ay kumana gakanaw ubba wode nagara oothosona. Wursethan, Xoossaa hanqoy enta bolla wodhees.
Teselonqe Asaa Be7anaw Amotees
Shin nu ishato, nuuni nu qofan gidonashin, ashon hintefe shaaketidi guutha wode gam7idaysan hintena daro laamotidi be7anaw koyida.
Nu simmi hinteko baanaw koyida. Taani ta huuphen hinteko baanaw koyas, shin Xalahey nuna diggis.
Hiza, nu Godaa Yesuus Kiristoosi yaa wode, nu ufaysay woyko nu ceeqetiya nu kallachay oonee? Hintena gideketiyee?
Tuma hinte nu bonchonne nu ufaysi.
